problem.problem_title: Tired of reading hundreds of pages of PDF?

problem.solution_title: Quizyen reads, summarizes, and asks questions for you.
problem.solution_desc: AI analyzes the content and turns it into an interactive, instructive experience. Strengthen your memory with active learning.

features.f1_desc: Upload any lecture notes, books, or articles. Our advanced reading module scans and understands content in seconds.
